# #138 - Oljan över 100 dollar fatet, fortsatt ränteoro, SaaS-renässans och koppar på ATH

**Feed**: montrosepodden  
**Published**: 2026-09-09  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts describe a nervous market. The Middle East conflict has dragged on, Brent crude is above $100 and the US 10-year yield has risen from 3.94% to 4.80%. Polymarket prices a 55-65% chance of a Fed rate hike, and the hosts fear food inflation will return, which could favour discount grocers like Axfood/Willys again. They also see a revival in software (SaaS) stocks led by cybersecurity names, discuss what OpenAI's Astra model means for AI lab valuations and upcoming IPOs, and end on copper at an all-time high, naming Lundin Mining, Boliden, Viscaria, Epiroc, Sandvik and FLSmidth as the stocks that benefit.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 AXFO — Axfood | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Down ~17.5% YTD, P/E ~18 on 2027 vs a 25 five-year average; could be a winner again if oil and fertiliser costs push food inflation back up.

#### Reasoning

Host Viktor says the discount-grocer thesis weakened as food inflation eased and City Gross underdelivered, lowering the multiple. If energy and fertiliser costs drive food prices up again, shoppers may return to Willys. The hosts frame it as something to follow this autumn, not an outright buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if food inflation does not return
- if City Gross keeps underperforming
- if consumers keep trading up to premium grocers

> *"Men Axfood och Willys kan ju bli en vinnare nu igen då om det är så att den här matinflationen av de anledningar vi nu pratar om, skulle komma tillbaka"*

---

### 🟠 RUSTA — Rusta | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Stable report; the hosts see a possible shift back toward low-price retailers this autumn.

#### Reasoning

Viktor lists Rusta with Clas Ohlson as low-price retailers that could benefit if inflation worries return, and says to keep an eye out this autumn.

#### Sell Triggers

- if inflation stays subdued
- if the next reports weaken

> *"Rusta kommer idag med en rapport som är ganska stabil. Vi får se om vi får det här skiftet nu mot den typen av bolag igen."*

---

### 🟠 LUMI — Lundin Mining | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

The clearest copper pure play; copper at an all-time high on the LME, up 47% year on year; strong operating leverage.

#### Reasoning

Host Niklas explains that higher copper prices raise revenue per tonne while costs stay flat, so profits grow faster than the metal price. Lundin is the purest way to play this, and higher copper prices lift cash flow directly. Demand comes from data centres, renewables and power grids, plus possible US tariffs on refined copper.

#### Sell Triggers

- if copper prices reverse
- if Trump does not extend tariffs to refined copper
- if data centre/grid demand slows

> *"där har vi det tydligaste pure-playet här av de här aktierna"*

---

### 🟠 BOL — Boliden | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Owns Aitik, Sweden's largest copper mine; the Laver project cleared government appeals; benefits via both mines and smelters.

#### Reasoning

Broader metals mix (zinc, gold, recycling) but strong copper exposure. The large Laver expansion is a long-term option, although many steps remain before an investment decision. Recent acquisitions add to growth.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Laver investment decision is delayed or blocked
- if copper prices fall

> *"Så ett högre kopparpris gynnar ju både egna gruvor och smältverksdivisionen."*

---

### 🟠 VISC — Viscaria | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Mine developer with high risk and high potential return; higher copper prices raise the project's present value.

#### Reasoning

Viscaria aims to open Sweden's first new copper mine in ~57 years. It is not yet in production, so this is speculative, but higher copper prices make the project more profitable on paper.

#### Sell Triggers

- if permitting or financing fails
- if copper prices fall

> *"det här är ett gruvutvecklingsbolag med hög risk och hög förväntad avkastning om det går vägen"*

---

### 🟠 FLS — FLSmidth | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Up 35%; falling ore grades mean more rock must be crushed, driving demand for high-margin wear parts.

#### Reasoning

As copper grades decline, larger volumes must be crushed and ground, which raises aftermarket demand for FLSmidth's higher-margin wear parts and spares.

#### Sell Triggers

- if mining capex slows
- if copper prices fall

> *"Det här driver en intensiv efterfrågan på FH Smiths slitelement och reservdelar."*

---

### 🟠 SAND — Sandvik | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Up 33%; high metal prices lead mining customers to invest in drill rigs, loaders and automation.

#### Reasoning

Sandvik Mining and Rock Solutions benefits as miners expand existing copper mines.

#### Sell Triggers

- if metal prices fall and miners cut capex

> *"ett högt Högre metallpris gör att gruvkunderna investerar i nya borriggar, lasthanterare och automation"*

---

### 🟠 EPI-A — Epiroc | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Up 22% YTD; named among mining equipment stocks leveraged to copper.

#### Reasoning

Epiroc is grouped with Sandvik as a supplier that benefits from mining capex. The discussion is cut off before any detail on Epiroc.

#### Sell Triggers

- if mining capex slows

> *"Epiroc upp 22 procent."*

---

### 🟠 YUBICO — Yubico | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Cybersecurity demand is rising as AI spreads; Yubico has rebounded strongly as a hardware-security winner.

#### Reasoning

The hosts argue that more powerful AI raises security needs; Yubico's physical keys are a Swedish way to play the cybersecurity theme.

#### Sell Triggers

- if cybersecurity momentum fades

> *"Ta ett Yubico i Sverige som också har studsat ordentligt."*

---

### 🟠 CRWD — CrowdStrike | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Up 78% YTD; the hosts say more AI means a greater need for cybersecurity.

#### Reasoning

Cybersecurity pure plays are highlighted as the clearest theme in the SaaS revival.

#### Sell Triggers

- if new AI models trigger a broad software selloff

> *"cybersäkerhet har verkligen kommit in i strålkastarljuset i takt med AI-boomen"*
